flags.text: Trailing-twelve-month revenue is ₹94,306 cr, +39% on the prior twelve months.
Trailing-twelve-month PAT is ₹7,033 cr, +70% on the prior twelve months.

business.what: Titan Company Limited is a lifestyle company primarily engaged in the jewellery, watches, and eyewear businesses. guidance.label: FY27 Jewellery EBIT margin
guidance.statement: The company intends to anchor its jewellery EBIT margin target at around 11% for FY27.
guidance.quote: I think we still, Mihir, would like to anchor our margin target at around 11%. Growth remains a priority... We would not, as far as FY27 is concerned, change our stance on margins.
guidance.speaker: Ashok Sonthalia

verdict.detail: Guidance for Jewellery, not the whole company; segment results are not in the headline financials.

guidance.label: Jewellery EBIT margin
guidance.statement: The jewellery business margin center of gravity is 11%, plus or minus something.
guidance.quote: more of 11% being the center of gravity for jewellery business margin, we would be around that plus/minus something can happen.
guidance.speaker: Ashok Sonthalia

verdict.detail: Guidance for Jewellery, not the whole company; segment results are not in the headline financials.

guidance.label: Jewellery business growth
guidance.statement: We are committed to a double-digit healthy growth in value in the jewellery business.
guidance.quote: we are committed to a double-digit healthy growth in value in the jewellery business.
guidance.speaker: Ajoy Chawla

verdict.detail: Guidance for Jewellery, not the whole company; segment results are not in the headline financials.

guidance.label: TEAL normalized margin
guidance.statement: The normalized margin for TEAL would be gradually gravitating towards 12% to 15%, 16%.
guidance.quote: the normalized margin would be gradually gravitating towards 12% to 15%, 16%.
guidance.speaker: Ashok Sonthalia

verdict.detail: Guidance for TEAL, not the whole company; segment results are not in the headline financials.

guidance.label: CaratLane EBIT margin
guidance.statement: CaratLane should inch towards double-digit EBIT margin.
guidance.quote: we have always thought that CaratLane should inch towards double- digit EBIT margin.
guidance.speaker: Ashok Sonthalia

verdict.detail: Guidance for CaratLane, not the whole company; segment results are not in the headline financials.

guidance.label: Jewellery sales growth
guidance.statement: We hope to maintain the 15% to 20% growth rate in the jewellery business.
guidance.quote: I think in the past, we have said between 15% to 20%. So, in a sense, that holds good and we hope to do that and maybe do a bit better.
guidance.speaker: Arun Narayan

verdict.detail: Guidance for Jewellery, not the whole company; segment results are not in the headline financials.

guidance.label: beYon store expansion
guidance.statement: We aim to scale up to 10 to 12 stores in two to three cities.
guidance.quote: we would certainly like to expand to around 10 to 12 stores in two to three cities and then kind of see how that... works for us
guidance.speaker: Arun Narayan

verdict.detail: Guidance for beYon, not the whole company; segment results are not in the headline financials.

guidance.label: CaratLane EBIT margin
guidance.statement: CaratLane will stay at a low double-digit EBIT margin profile.
guidance.quote: I think they would stay there, low double-digit margin EBIT profile.
guidance.speaker: Ashok Sonthalia

verdict.detail: Guidance for CaratLane, not the whole company; segment results are not in the headline financials.

guidance.label: Tanishq store openings
guidance.statement: The target for new Tanishq store openings for the year remains 40.
guidance.quote: I think overall, for the year, our target remains 40 barring -- I mean, subject to some execution.
guidance.speaker: Ajoy Chawla

verdict.detail: Guidance for Jewellery, not the whole company; segment results are not in the headline financials.

guidance.label: Eyewear revenue growth
guidance.statement: The company expects to close the year with a growth rate between 13% and 14%.
guidance.quote: we believe that we should be closing this year at a slightly higher number than what you are seeing, anywhere between 13% to 14%.
guidance.speaker: N. S. Raghavan

verdict.detail: Guidance for Eyewear, not the whole company; segment results are not in the headline financials.

guidance.label: Watches business margin
guidance.statement: The watches business aims for mid-teen margins of 15% to 16% in the 1-2 year timeframe.
guidance.quote: mid-teen is a good number to aim for, 15% to 16% for the business, at least in the 1-year, 2-year time frame.
guidance.speaker: Ashok Sonthalia

verdict.detail: Guidance for Watches & Wearables, not the whole company; segment results are not in the headline financials.

guidance.label: Jewellery segment EBIT margin
guidance.statement: The company maintains its guidance for the jewellery segment EBIT margin to be between 11% and 11.5%.
guidance.quote: 11 to 11.5 still remains our guidance on which we are trying to work on.
guidance.speaker: Ashok Sonthalia

verdict.detail: Guidance for Jewellery, not the whole company; segment results are not in the headline financials.

guidance.label: Watches division EBIT margin
guidance.statement: The company expects to deliver mid-teen EBIT margins for the watches division for the full year.
guidance.quote: I think we are hopeful that mid-teen kind of number we should be able to deliver full year basis for FY ‘26.
guidance.speaker: Ashok Sonthalia

verdict.detail: Guidance for Watches, not the whole company; segment results are not in the headline financials.

claims.claim: The normalized EBIT margin for the Titan Jewellery business in Q2 FY27 was 11.1% after adjusting for customs duty gains.
claims.quote: Normalized margin, once you do adjustment for this, on Titan Jewellery business would be 11.1%.

claims.claim: The Titan Jewellery business margin would be 11.7% if normalized for both customs duty gains and MTM gain reversals.
claims.quote: And if you normalize for that, then TMZ, which is Titan Jewellery business margin, would be 11.7%.

claims.claim: The company observed a secular trend of increased consumer interest in natural diamonds starting from January 2026.
claims.quote: And from January of this year, we are seeing a secular trend where customers are demonstrating greater interest in natural diamonds.

claims.claim: Competitive intensity in the jewellery industry is expected to continue to increase as more players enter the market and expand.
claims.quote: Competitive intensity, please expect it to continue to improve and increase all the time. More players will come, more people get capital, more people want to expand.

claims.claim: Jewellery division EBIT margin was impacted by 75-80 bps due to accounting MTM in inventory.
claims.quote: we have accounting MTM in the inventory, which is -- which caused 75 to 80 basis point jewellery division EBIT upward.

claims.claim: Consumer sentiment was soft for 3 weeks in May due to customs duty changes and Adhik Maas, but recovered in June.
claims.quote: we did see a softness in consumer sentiment for about 3 weeks' time till the end of May. But by the beginning of June, things started picking up.

claims.claim: The normalized EBIT margin for Tanishq, Mia, and Zoya business was 10.9% for the quarter.
claims.quote: the normalized EBIT margin for our Tanishq Mia Zoya business would be 10.9%, the number for this quarter.

claims.claim: The company realized ₹407 crores in gains from the customs duty rate increase from 6% to 15%.
claims.quote: we had overall at a consolidated level realization of ₹407 crores, ₹386 crores was in Tanishq Mia Zoya portfolio and ₹21 crores was in CaratLane.

claims.claim: Titan gained 50 to 60 bps market share in the jewellery business in FY26 versus FY25.
claims.quote: Our sense is that perhaps we have gained about 50 to 60 bps is our sense on FY26 versus FY25.

claims.claim: Buyer growth in Q4 reached 8% compared to flat growth in the previous nine months.
claims.quote: we have seen resurgence in buyer growth in Quarter 4 and what we have reported is 8% versus a flattish for the period prior to that.

claims.claim: The international business became profitable at the operating level for the full year FY26.
claims.quote: one of the positive news for international business, if you look at the full year, at operating level, they became profitable.

claims.claim: The unallocated loss of ₹100-₹120 crores in Q4 was due to a special reward shared with employees.
claims.quote: Titan, in past also we have spoken about, we have a tradition of sharing that superlative performance by sharing, we call it special reward... It is about ₹100- ₹120 crores roughly.

claims.claim: Jewellery margins are under pressure due to rising gold prices, but absolute EBIT/PBT growth remains strong.
claims.quote: In the continuously rising gold prices, jewellery margins will kind of exhibit this kind of pressure. But absolute... have been growing nicely recently

claims.claim: The company is seeing positive traction in jewellery demand despite high gold prices, aided by wedding season and FOMO.
claims.quote: lot of customers really jumped in on account of this entire FOMO (fear of missing out), and I feel that is continuing even now.

claims.claim: The company's ability to fund inventory provides a competitive advantage over smaller players in a high-cost environment.
claims.quote: it puts us, in a, I would say, a bit, not huge, but it's an advantage, competitive advantage for us because we are able to at least fund our inventory

claims.claim: The company acquired a 67% stake in Damas, with consolidation starting from January 1, 2026.
claims.quote: We are very happy to announce that we completed 67% stake acquisition of Damas. And the accounting of that, you will see from 1st January

claims.claim: Post-Diwali sales growth has continued in the same vein as the festive period.
claims.quote: post festive 10 days also that we have seen post the Diwali action, the sales growth has continued to be in the same vein as we saw in festive.

claims.claim: Titan has gained market share in East and South India.
claims.quote: if you are asking geographically, we have gained share in East and South -- or rather we continue to gain share in East and South driven by our regionalization strategy

claims.claim: The company does not see any net impact on margins from the reversal of the Q1 inventory rebalance benefit.
claims.quote: in quarter 2, we didn't see any net impact of reversal and accrual.

claims.claim: Titan Engineering & Automation Limited (TEAL) has no synergy with the consumer businesses.
claims.quote: no, there is no real synergy between TEAL and the consumer businesses.

claims.claim: The company sustained its national market share in the jewellery segment during Q1.
claims.quote: Quarter 1 summary, we have I think sustained share nationally.

claims.claim: Q1 jewellery margins included a 50 bps one-time benefit from hedging that will reverse in Q2 and Q3.
claims.quote: This is also one time outstanding hedging because of so much volatility in the market. There is MTM again sitting in our favour and which will also as these forwards and futures gets squared up in quarter 2 and quarter 3, this will also reverse itself.

claims.claim: Q1 watches margins included a 4% one-time benefit from inventory revaluation that will reverse in Q2 and Q3.
claims.quote: In watches division, we have some valuation of inventory which we do annually... this time it was pretty marked and that adjust watches division reported margin by almost 4%.

claims.claim: The lab-grown diamond market is estimated to be less than 2% of the total diamond studded market.
claims.quote: The reality is that, the lab grown market estimated by us is less than 2% of the total diamond studded market, as we speak.

synthesis.one_liner: Titan shows soaring top and bottom-line growth, but cash conversion is poor and leverage has risen sharply.

narrative_vs_numbers.says: Management emphasizes strong trailing-twelve-month revenue of ₹94,306 cr, reflecting robust retail demand and lifestyle expansion.
narrative_vs_numbers.shows: Over 5 years, operating cash flow was only ₹7,390 cr from ₹27,569 cr of operating profit, a 27% conversion rate.

narrative_vs_numbers.says: Management points to healthy operational execution and stable normalized segment margins despite rising competitive intensity.
narrative_vs_numbers.shows: Profit compounded at 17% over 3 years versus 29% for revenue, showing growth costs margin, though operating margin reached 14.5% in Sep 2026.

narrative_vs_numbers.says: Management highlights positive traction in jewellery demand and effective inventory deployment during high gold price environments.
narrative_vs_numbers.shows: The cash conversion cycle lengthened to 211 days from 191 days in Mar 2023, driven by inventory days rising from 199 to 222.

synthesis.credibility: Management provides extensive segment targets, all currently unmeasured by headline financials. The ledger records zero evaluated items out of 13 guidance points, leaving historical say-do performance opaque while leverage increases.

bull.evidence: Trailing-twelve-month revenue reached ₹94,306 cr, up 39% on the prior twelve months.
Sep 2026 quarter PAT grew 114% year-on-year to ₹2,393 cr with an operating margin of 14.5%.
Operating margin expanded by 4.5 percentage points to 14.5% from 10.0% a year ago.

bear.evidence: Borrowings reached ₹27,638 cr against equity of ₹18,263 cr, lifting debt-to-equity to 1.51x from 0.79x.
Quarterly revenue YoY growth slowed over four quarters from 80.5% in Mar 2026 to 10.1% in Sep 2026.
Free cash flow was negative in 2 of the last 5 years, with cumulative FCF at ₹4,736 cr.
